title: Action strength of analog input is affected by digital input
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.4.1-stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.5599) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600H with Radeon Graphics (12 threads)

### Issue description

When having an input map with both an analog and a digital input mapped to the same action like so: 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9c5c6e54-a3fa-45d3-8009-da26402ebc19)

and printing out the output when tilting the left analog stick to the right like so:

```
func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	var dir: = Vector2.ZERO
	dir.x = Input.get_action_strength("right") - Input.get_action_strength("left")
	dir.y = Input.get_action_strength("down") - Input.get_action_strength("up")
	print(dir)
```

```
output:
...
(0.368076, 0.0)
(0.386235, 0.0)
(0.394589, 0.0)
(0.400502, 0.0)
(0.404508, 0.0)
(0.404508, 0.0)
(1.0, 0.0)
(1.0, 0.0)
(1.0, 0.0)
...
```

The range of the analog input is lessened to approximately 0-0.4 instead of the full 0-1 range when calling `Input.get_action_strength`. When there is only the analog input mapped to the action, the full range is regained.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create an action with both an analog and a digital input
2. print the action strength while increasing the analog input
3. Notice the cutoff at around 0.4

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[controller-input-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19671768/controller-input-mrp.zip)
